title: Shops & Establishment Act — State Legislation (demo excerpt)

sections.content: Shops & Establishment registration is administered independently by each Indian state, with its own Act, thresholds, exemptions, and renewal cycle -- there is no single national threshold. This system does not yet have verified state-specific rules loaded, so applicability cannot be automatically determined; the deterministic Rules Engine marks this obligation as requiring manual review rather than guessing a threshold. labour.gov.in (Ministry of Labour & Employment) is referenced here only as a general pointer, not a substitute for the specific state Act. This is a system-generated summary, not verbatim statute text.
